snippet.title: Retrace the Light - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Our 2.5D top-down action-adventure RPG “Retrace The Light” is now officially released on Steam and Epic Games Store! 

Play as the Enforcer Decem, stepping into the perilous “Mirrormaze” .Utilize a unique retrace mechanic to uncover the key to breaking through the crisis. The combat system maintains the challenging depth of a hardcore action game while featuring intricate rhythm control and skill design, delivering the exhilarating satisfaction of outmaneuvering foes in battle.

Throughout your journey, you'll face a series of fate-altering choices. Your actions will shape the story's direction, crafting a truly unique experience that is yours alone.
Steam Link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179370?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=scheduled&utm_medium=pv
